description: This file contains functions and variables related to platform upgrade routines for a Linux-based embedded system. The script handles image verification, partition management, bootloader upgrade, and overall system upgrade steps.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the image type, extracts partition information, and compares partition tables to determine whether an upgrade should proceed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the appropriate partition during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_bootloader_upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the system's bootloader by mounting the boot partition and invoking grub-bios-setup.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the full upgrade process, including partition handling, image writing, and bootloader update.
